reuse.why: Adds the exclusion to the existing shared getBudgetActionCategories filter and BudgetActionEligibility type, so every month-wide action applies it.

duplication.why: The same `CASE WHEN instr(COALESCE(n.note, ''), '#fixed') ...` column and notes JOIN is pasted into six separate SQL queries.

placement.why: Eligibility decision sits in the shared filter where hidden/template rules live; tag detection is in SQL next to the other eligibility columns, following the existing query pattern.

scope.why: Only budget actions eligibility and its test are changed.

maintainability.why: Changing how the #fixed tag is detected (e.g. word boundaries) needs six identical edits; the eligibility SELECT should have been factored once.

one_place.where: The skip decision is in getBudgetActionCategories, but the #fixed tag detection is copied into getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg SQL in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts
